newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Parliament approves Israel Aircraft debt accord.
newsitem.headline: Parliament approves Israel Aircraft debt accord.

text.p: The parliamentary finance committee approved a proposal that will enable banks to renew credit to debt-ridden Israel Aircraft Industries, the Finance Ministry said.

Under the accord the banks will reschedule $330 million in IAI debt for up to eight years and provide the state-owned company with $120 million in new credit, part of which will be backed by government guarantees.
At the same time the government will increase the company's equity by $122 million and the banks will release $180 million due IAI and frozen in closed accounts because of the company's debts.
The accord, hammered out between the government, banks and IAI, will enable the company to pay off its debts to local suppliers, IAI said.
The Haaretz newspaper said IAI's debt with its suppliers amounted to about $200 million.
